title: Void Shrine
description: A shrine that exists and doesn't exist simultaneously, flickering between states of being with each heartbeat. Candles that burn with black flame illuminate carvings in a language that predates creation. The altar at its center holds a crystallized fragment of pure void, and the air thrums with a quiet, patient hunger.

choices.label: Commune with the void
choices.description: Open your mind to the vast emptiness and let its strange peace flow through the party.

choices.label: Offer gold to the shrine
choices.description: Place coins upon the flickering altar and receive the void's deeper blessing.

choices.label: Take the void crystal
choices.description: Seize the crystallized void from the altar before the shrine flickers out of existence.

choices.label: Leave the shrine
choices.description: The shrine's hunger is patient, but you are not willing to feed it.
